title: Health session
description: A normalized sleep, stress, or other bounded health session.

startTime.description: The session start time in ISO 8601 format.

endTime.description: The session end time in ISO 8601 format.

localDate.description: The associated local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used to interpret the session and its local date.

score.description: The normalized session score when supplied by the source.

summary.description: Normalized summary values for the session.

sourceBreakdown.description: The privacy-reviewed provider candidates and selection evidence used to select this canonical session.

computedAt.description: The time the canonical session was last computed in ISO 8601 format.

source.description: The system or user action that originally supplied this record.

sourceExternalId.description: The stable record identifier assigned by the source system, when available.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: The last modification time reported by the source system in ISO 8601 format.
